name: Siddhesvara Dham (Char Dham Temple)
town_description: Namchi is the headquarters of Namchi district (South Sikkim), about 78 km from Gangtok, and a major religious-tourism hub of the state with the Char Dham, Samdruptse (Guru Padmasambhava statue) and the Sai Mandir.

travel.airport: Bagdogra Airport, West Bengal, about 102 km from Namchi (per namchi.nic.in); Pakyong Airport near Gangtok is closer by air distance (verify).
travel.railway: New Jalpaiguri (NJP) Station, West Bengal, about 96 km from Namchi.
travel.road: About 92 km from Siliguri; SNT buses and shared/private taxis run regularly from Namchi town; Solophok hill is 5 km from Namchi town on the Melli-Jorethang route.

visitor_information.best_time: March to May and October to December for clear mountain views of Kanchenjunga and the valleys.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Reported as 8:00/9:00 AM to 5:00 PM daily in most sources; one source lists 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM - verify before visiting (per 901.json).
